items.reason: A gentle-to-start nightly gel that suits adult skin and is fine for you to keep in your cart.
Retinoid-type ingredients make skin more sun-sensitive, so a daily mineral SPF is needed alongside the gel.

response.routine_note: Because three months of shop-bought products hasn't changed how your skin looks, we'd suggest seeing a dermatologist rather than adding more products from us. Meanwhile, use the gel at night, starting every second night, and apply the SPF every morning.
